options.label: Get All Leads
options.description: Retrieve all leads with optional filtering, sorting

options.label: Get Lead
options.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific lead including all associated data and history

options.label: Add Lead
options.description: Create a new lead with all necessary details including contact information and source

options.label: Update Lead
options.description: Update an existing lead with new information including status, contact details, and source

options.label: Delete Lead
options.description: Permanently delete a specific lead from the system

options.label: Search Leads
options.description: Search for leads using various criteria including name, email, and source information

options.label: Get Permitted Users For Lead
options.description: Retrieve all users who have permission to access a specific lead

options.label: Add Lead Label
options.description: Create a new lead label with all necessary details including name and color configuration

options.label: Update Lead Label
options.description: Update an existing lead label with new information including name and color configuration

options.label: Get Lead Conversion Status
options.description: Get conversion status of a lead (BETA)

options.label: Convert Lead to Deal
options.description: Convert a lead to a deal (BETA)
